values: Cyanide effluent limitation values and any interim-limit provisions specified elsewhere in the permit
rationale: The packet includes the cyanide schedule-of-compliance milestone ('Achieve Final Effluent Limitations 12 months after permit effective date') and adjacent structural context (TDS footnotes *10–*11 with explicit limit-start timing, WET footnote *9 on monitoring start). It does not include the cyanide effluent limitation numeric values, any interim-limit provisions for cyanide, or the permit effective date. The schedule language alone states a compliance-achievement deadline; it does not establish whether final cyanide limits are enforceable for compliance comparison from the permit effective date or only after the 12-month milestone. Without the cyanide limit table, interim provisions, and effective date, neither ACCEPT (limits enforceable throughout the term with the 12-month date as a milestone only) nor REJECT (limits not enforceable until 12 months after effective date) can be grounded. Per P5, unsupported uncertainty is preferred to unsupported semantic closure.
